page.content:
LAPD unit that retires escaped replicants.

How Blade Runners connects

  • Character: Rick Deckard — Deckard is a blade runner pulled back onto the job.
  • Character: Officer K — K is a replicant blade runner of the Wallace era.
  • Weapon: Voight-Kampff — Blade runners use the Voight-Kampff test to identify replicants.
  • Character: Gaff — Gaff is the origami-folding blade runner beside Deckard.

What is Blade Runners?

Blade runners are the special police who hunt replicants: Deckard in 2019, Gaff beside him, and K in the Wallace era.

Key threads lead to Rick Deckard, Officer K, Voight-Kampff and Gaff.
